'''Jayke Ball There Is Good In Him LS''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Jayke Ball]] posted on DeckTech. The published title is not used as the page title; it appears in the original post below.<ref name="dt-12227">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12227 DeckTech post 12227], DeckTech (Jayke "Lord_vader20" Ball, 10 December 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/12227/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/12227/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018085627/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12227/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jayke Ball]]
* '''Published:''' 10 December 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif|label=There Is Good In Him}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 TIGIH Ball LS 2000 12227.txt |Download]] (omits Docking Bay, Obbysian Ornament, Den of Thieves: not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' this is an EVIL TIGIH deck that thromps on you with eloms,obi, jedi luke, and inserters. It walks up to your dark side deck and says SUCK MY BALLS

The post names no Defensive Shields.

The post also lists 1x Docking Bay, 2x Obbysian Ornament, 1x Den of Thieves, which matches no known card; it is shown as posted and counted in the published total.

== Original post ==

'''Sucez Mes Boules (suck my balls)'''
* '''Author:''' Jayke "Lord_vader20" Ball
* '''Published:''' December 10, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 3.5
* '''Description:''' this is an EVIL TIGIH deck that thromps on you with eloms,obi, jedi luke, and inserters. It walks up to your dark side deck and says SUCK MY BALLS

=== Strategy ===

Ok first off, I got the deck name when I was fooling around listening to south Park the Movie"in French on my Playstation 2. I thought it would be funny. ok heres the strategy

if they have imperials at sites, they are screwed from the start. Use luke to drain early, then if they come marching in, just give them luke. Stack up alittle force if you have to, then drop a crew of e-loms with obi-and lay the smack down. Grab all thier important interups, try to get your insert out eraly, before you deploy obi-wan. Then use cival dissorder and I hope she is allright to make then lose alot of force for not deploying. If they manage to get out more guys than you, just use your savrip and forfet some Big SHips. Stack up cards quick on Your Destiny and cross vader, and win. AGAINST CERTAIN DECKS Huntdown, Beatdown big time with eloms, kill of vader and use your inserts to win. Bothans to kill of Visage Ralltiir- You win Occupation- You win Court- Beatdown if they drop mara, use inserts to win, if not, run around killing with jedi luke. BHBM- GIve them luke, win alot of battles, then use bothans and eloms to kill of vader and emporer at DS2 throne room Inserts YOu win Ties Deploy all ships at once, with dubs for forfit with savrip ISB constant battles, use spies to go to thier 2/0 sites and kill them, if they have any imperials, they are screwed. ANything else, just react to what your opponent is doing. remeber, if they have imperials, you should win.
